title: Ylang ylang and jasmine room spray
subtitle: A rich floral room spray for bedrooms
excerpt: A room spray of ylang ylang and jasmine absolute in perfumers' alcohol and distilled water. Ylang ylang gives a heavy, tropical floral with banana notes; jasmine absolute is warm and honeyed. Used sparingly, both are strong at higher concentrations. Makes 100 ml. Shelf life 12 months.
sourceNotes: Ylang ylang (Cananga odorata) essential oil: intensely sweet, floral-banana aroma; main constituents germacrene-D, benzyl acetate, linalool. Strong at concentration, 1% in a room spray is sufficient; higher concentrations can be overpowering and cause headache in sensitive individuals. Jasmine absolute (Jasminum grandiflorum or sambac): warm, honeyed, indolic floral; very expensive but a little goes far. At 0.5% in a spray the indolic character is pleasant. Combined: ylang at 1% + jasmine at 0.5% = 1.5% total fragrance at 100 ml spray volume. Perfumers' alcohol base 20% to dissolve. Sunflower lecithin or Solubol at 4x EO weight can reduce visible oiliness on surfaces if needed.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Leave for 24 hours to mature before first use. Shake before each use.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 12 months sealed. The jasmine absolute is the most stable component. Ylang ylang can develop a slightly sharp note after 12 months, it remains usable but less pleasant.

glossaryTerms.definition: A fragrance extract produced by solvent extraction rather than steam distillation. Absolutes capture heat-sensitive aromatic compounds (like jasmine's indolic notes) that distillation destroys. They are more concentrated and true-to-flower than essential oils distilled from the same plant.

content.text: Ylang ylang and jasmine room spray is a rich floral blend for bedrooms and dressing rooms. Ylang ylang brings a heavy, tropical flower note with a distinctive banana-sweet character; jasmine
adds a warm, honeyed depth. Both are strong, use 1-2 sprays and leave the room briefly. The blend settles to a softer, rounded floral after a few minutes. Makes 100 ml; keeps 12 months.

items.prepNote: complete grade; 1% of total spray; heady floral
0.5% of total spray; very costly — substitute jasmine absolute FO if price is a concern
added last; shake before each use

content.text: Add the essential oil and jasmine absolute to the perfumers' alcohol in the spray bottle. Swirl to dissolve.
Add the distilled water. Cap and shake. Leave for 24 hours before first use.
Shake before each use. Spray into the air in the centre of the room, not directly at fabric or pillows.
12 months. Store away from heat. The alcohol is flammable, keep from open flames.
